periods.glance: Korea, 1886 to 1897: monarchy. About 13.8 million people in 1886 (model estimate). Official religion: Neo-Confucianism. Leaders: Gojong of the Korean Empire.

Korea, 1898 to 1910: constitutional monarchy, absolute monarchy. About 13.9 million people in 1898 (model estimate). Religion recorded on Wikidata: Christianity, Buddhism. Leaders: Gojong of the Korean Empire, Sunjong of the Korean Empire, Terauchi Masatake.
